title: Credit notes a cent off their invoices: add-half-then-floor rounding duplicated in money and VAT code

hidden_checks.spec: Rule 1: halves go away from zero: -0.125 -> -0.13, -2.5 -> -3 for places=0.
Rule 1 (0.125 -> 0.13, 2.5 -> 3) and rule 7: positive amounts must not change.
Rule 1: non-half values round to the nearest step.
Rule 1: for every Decimal x, round_half_up(-x, p) == -round_half_up(x, p); halves away from zero.
Rule 3: line_tax is net * rate rounded by rule 1 for positive and negative nets alike.
Rule 3 + acceptance: every place the package rounds money follows rule 1.
Rule 3: an unknown category still raises billing.tax.UnknownTaxCategory.
Reproduction: invoice total prints 25.97 (rule 2 net rounding; rule 7 positives unchanged).
Rule 2: unit prices may be negative (adjustment lines), net rounded by rule 1; rule 3 VAT.
Rules 3/4: VAT per line by rule 1; breakdown() sums per category as today.
Rule 2: net = qty * unit_price * (1 - discount) rounded by rule 1; quantities may be negative.
Acceptance: the reproduction prints 25.97 and -25.97; rule 5 full mirror.
Rule 5: every line net/tax/gross, subtotal, tax_total, total and breakdown value is the exact negative.
Rule 5: every split(weights) share of a full credit note is the exact negative of the invoice's.
Rule 6: partial credit note amounts equal the negatives of an invoice for those n units.
Rules 2 and 6: refunding an adjustment line (negative unit price) negates it exactly.
Rules 1-5 and 7 for any inputs, not just the example (acceptance criteria).
Rule 7: no change to how ties are allocated in billing.split.allocate (existing behavior).
Rule 5/7: split of a negative total mirrors the positive split (existing documented behavior).
